name: Gendershift Potion
description: A sickly sweet, bubbly liquid. These potions are incredibly difficult to craft; however, they require relatively mundane and easy to get ingredients. As such, the Shopkeep has offered this potion for free.
effect: The vast majority of Pokemon require this potion to be consumed to cause their sex to shift. The potion must be consumed each time a Pokemon wants to change sex.
